related_questions.question: What is the alternative simplified credit on form 6765?
related_questions.snippet: The Alternative Simplified Credit (ASC) is an option that simplifies the calculation of the R&D tax credit. On Form 6765, you calculate the ASC by taking 14% of the amount by which your qualified research expenses for the tax year exceed 50% of the average qualified research expenses for the three preceding tax years.
